labeling_protocol: Labels assigned from NCM title/artist/album metadata, the frozen manifest, and external release knowledge; no engine suggestion events were consulted for these labels. The 5 'Soda Pop' instances are marked disclosed-v0.1 because their v0.1 suggestion was seen. The leader disclosed aggregate post-fix behavior (55/57 genre.k-pop) before labelling; that is aggregate only and is disclosed in every row's audit note.
bias_disclosures: Aggregate provider result (55/57 genre.k-pop) was disclosed by the leader before this labelling pass; per-track suggestions were not.
Live external page fetches failed in this runtime; release years rely on search-result titles plus known release facts. MUSI-14's MusicBrainz lookup is the independent cross-check.
Genre for hip-hop/R&B-leaning K-pop works is recorded at the umbrella (genre.k-pop) level; co-primary subgenres are noted but not asserted, to avoid inflating expected-tag recall.
Taxonomy v1.0.0 has no genre.ballad, genre.soundtrack, or film-score tag; ballad and score works are mapped to the closest valid tag and the gap is recorded, not silently redefined.
